authority: Protected acquisition/store and frozen host issuer authority required. Receipt authentication does not establish truth or independent reviewer competence by self-declaration.
live_acceptance: Both causal metric dimension sets must pass on the same output; all active dimensions for other tasks pass. Failed/held review remains consumed, counted, retained, without automatic resubmission or inference.
not_applicable: Allowed for explicit decline, or ethics necessity/proportionality strictly after actual verified failed stopping rung. No N/A dimension silently passes; metric outcome uses only contract-declared active dimensions. Other missing/uncertain support is held.
outcome: Wrong answer remains WRONG; correct with active fail -> WRONG_BASIS; correct with held or no checkable basis -> UNSCOREABLE; correct with every active dimension pass -> RIGHT.
reviewer_input: Actual raw answer/basis/output, input, original host sources/context and calculations; exclude expected/reference basis/metric results.
source_metadata_composition: Applicability/witness review retains exact existing typed public source metadata, member/span lineage, observation kind, qualifier origin and day/month/unknown precision. Unknown publication cannot pass a known-age requirement; month is never promoted to a day. A producer qualifier or generator/update/review/event/capture observation cannot authenticate publisher publication. Actual protected import/authority remains host-held, not reviewer- or child-appointed.
support: Every dimension has independent actual reason and source/context witness locations; pass requires checkable supporting witnesses. Exact bytes/value identity is necessary, never sufficient semantic support.

task_checks.causal: Review sign, lag, PERT magnitude, units/temporal interpretation and grade separately against actual original evidence/calculations; significance and generic mechanisms cannot fill quantities. Each grade claim retains actual evidence author/authority; human grade 4 cannot be self-created.
task_checks.ethics: Authenticate actual policy/sensor/completion provenance, ordered rung prefix, denial cause and mandatory DPIA; no general gameability/ethics or human signoff authority.
task_checks.evolution: Position is about this capability/adopter/date/frame; source coordinate in another frame cannot supply support.
task_checks.gameplay: Assess every positive and negative component/play precondition against whole pinned graph; exact complete set and own-overlay scope. No rival-absence inference; land-grab incumbency stays unchecked, as current catalogue declares.

versioning: Signal v1 remains byte-compatible; task v2 binds exact dimensions, typed witness verifier and explicit applicability rules into policy/source identity.
